title: Value of Inner Qualities in Islam
summary: True worth in the afterlife depends on inner qualities, not physical appearance.
translation: A person should never think that having a large, imposing, powerful body, or looking beautiful grants them true value. In worldly terms, this may bring recognition, but in the hereafter, only good character, piety, good dealings, and righteous actions will matter. As the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) made clear in a Hadith, a large and strong person with no good deeds will have no worth before Allah. In a Hadith by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him), the Prophet stated that a well-built person will hold no more weight than a mosquito's wing on the Day of Judgment. The Quran similarly states, 'We will not establish any weight for them on the Day of Resurrection.' This Hadith reveals that Allah values internal qualities such as deeds, faith, piety, and sincerity, not external appearance. Thus, believers are encouraged to uphold piety, strengthening their faith to attain real worth in Allah's view.
